solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Excellent sweet

definitions.meaning: in ... condition means perfect, as new, so excellent
a peppermint is a sweet, a small confection

explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: brand-new and flawless as an adjective, and a peppermint confection as a noun.

clue.text: Man and another taken around his best friend's house?

parts.note: Ken is a man's name

indicators.note: taken around means the name for the other man is turned back to front

parts.note: another man's name, Len

explanation.surface: Two men are shown round the home of one of their mates.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition rests on the saying that a dog is man's best friend, so 'his' points back to the Man at the start of the clue.
explanation.definitionFit: A dog is called man's best friend, and a dog's shelter or hut is its home.

clue.text: Minister's Select Committee (Northern Ireland) finally listed

definitions.note: read as 'minister is', with the verb to minister meaning to look after

indicators.note: the final letters of each of the listed words are taken in turn

explanation.surface: A parliamentary committee on Northern Ireland has at last been put on the schedule for a government minister.
explanation.walkthrough: Read 'Minister's' as 'minister is': to minister to someone is to look after them. The parenthesis is part of the fodder, not an aside.
explanation.definitionFit: To minister to someone and to look after them are synonyms, as a priest cares for his flock.

clue.text: Inferior head travelling south, as far as European location

indicators.note: the first letter, the head of the word, moves further down in this down clue

parts.note: poor quality is inferior quality
to, as in 'up to' or 'as far as'

explanation.surface: A second-rate boss heads south on a long journey to somewhere on the Continent.
explanation.walkthrough: 'head travelling south' moves the P of POOR down one place, giving OPOR. OPORTO is the old English name for Porto in Portugal.
explanation.definitionFit: Porto, long called Oporto in English, is a port city in northern Portugal.

clue.text: Heaps of work put into stories following overseas agreement

indicators.note: following means the stories with work inside come after the foreign yes

parts.note: ja is yes in German and Dutch, agreement from abroad

indicators.note: put into means the work is placed inside the stories

parts.note: lies are untrue stories
op is short for opus, a work

explanation.surface: A pile of writing is slotted into tales once a deal is struck abroad.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Heaps' looks like a quantity; it is slang for clapped-out cars. OP goes into LIES to make LOPIES.
explanation.definitionFit: A heap is slang for a decrepit old car, as is a jalopy.

clue.text: Believe judge, maybe? It's deliberate

definitions.meaning: to believe is to think and to judge is to think too, so the same word appears two times
to deliberate is to reconsider carefully before acting

explanation.definitionFit: Believe and judge both mean think, giving the word twice; and to reconsider before deciding is to deliberate.

clue.text: Smart alec guy entertaining marine corps to begin with

indicators.note: entertaining means holding the other letters inside, as a host holds guests

parts.note: a guy is a rope or wire bracing a mast or tent
marine means of the sea

indicators.note: to begin with means only the opening letter of corps is used

explanation.surface: A cocky fellow plays host to the Marine Corps.
explanation.walkthrough: 'guy' looks like a man; it is a guy wire. 'Marine corps' splits into SEA and C.
explanation.definitionFit: A smart alec is a know-all, someone who parades their cleverness; the older word means the same.

clue.text: Old fashion designer digesting northern guide

indicators.note: digesting means taking the other letter inside

parts.note: Coco Chanel, the French couturier of the early twentieth century

explanation.surface: A veteran couturier takes in a northern style guide.
explanation.definitionFit: To channel something is to direct or steer it along a course.

clue.text: Excellent training in pain

parts.note: PE is physical education, training for the body
achy means aching, in pain

explanation.surface: Exercise is going great even though it hurts.
explanation.definitionFit: Peachy is informal for fine or splendid, like something as good as a ripe peach.

clue.text: Lines of bronze inlaid in small unknown area

indicators.note: inlaid in means set into the other letters

parts.note: in algebra, x, y and z are unknowns
a tan is a bronze colour on the skin

explanation.surface: Bronze strips are set into a little patch of unidentified ground.
explanation.definitionFit: A stanza is a group of lines forming a verse of a poem.

clue.text: Part of France finished when crossing river trail

indicators.note: crossing means stretching across, so the other letters sit within it

parts.note: done means finished
to dog someone is to follow or trail them

explanation.surface: A walk in France ends when a footpath fords a river.
explanation.definitionFit: The Dordogne is a department and river valley in south-western France.

clue.text: Sponsor husband in hospital trip rescheduled around November

indicators.note: around means the rearranged letters surround the letter for November
rescheduled means the trip's letters are rearranged into a new order

parts.note: N is November in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: A patient's partner has to rearrange a hospital visit for some time around November.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rescheduled' scrambles H plus HOSPITAL TRIP, and 'around' wraps those letters around N.
explanation.definitionFit: A benefactor who backs good causes with money can be called a sponsor.

clue.text: Sorrow thus seen in hater?

parts.note: the word hater is what you get if you break up the letters of the organ that pumps blood

explanation.surface: Someone who hates looks like they are carrying grief.
explanation.walkthrough: This is a reverse clue: read the answer as an instruction, an anagram of HEART with BREAK as the signal, and it gives HATER.
explanation.definitionFit: Heartbreak is overwhelming grief, so sorrow is a fair synonym.

clue.text: Hard Mike restrained by Robert's powerful arm

parts.note: H is the abbreviation for hard, as on pencils

indicators.note: restrained by means held inside the other letters

parts.note: Bob is short for Robert
M is Mike in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: Tough Mike is held back by Robert's strong arm.
explanation.walkthrough: 'arm' looks like a limb; it is a weapon.
explanation.definitionFit: A hydrogen bomb is a nuclear weapon, and arms are weapons.

clue.text: Just fine

definitions.meaning: fine weather is dry and pleasant

explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: equitable, treating people rightly; and pleasant, dry weather.

clue.text: Finale of The Archers broadcast in study

indicators.note: broadcast means scattered, so the letters are rearranged
the finale is the end, so only the closing letter of the word is taken

explanation.surface: The last episode of the BBC radio soap The Archers goes out on air in a studio.
explanation.walkthrough: THE ARCHERS is a long-running BBC radio soap about a farming village. 'broadcast' scrambles E plus ARCHERS.
explanation.definitionFit: Research is detailed investigation, a careful study of a subject.

clue.text: Free spectacles found in famous school

indicators.note: found in means placed inside the other letters

parts.note: LSE is the London School of Economics
OO looks like a pair of glasses

explanation.surface: Someone has been handed out a pair of glasses at a well-known college.
explanation.definitionFit: Loose means unconfined or at liberty, as an animal is let loose.

clue.text: Male sacked by 24 concealing deep mission

indicators.note: concealing means hiding the other letters inside
sacked by means the male letter is dismissed from the word

parts.note: the answer to 24 down, a television trophy
bass is the deepest singing voice

explanation.surface: A man is fired by an awards body that covers up a secret operation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sacked by' removes one M from EMMY, leaving EMY, which then hides BASS.
explanation.definitionFit: A diplomatic mission is an ambassador's staff and office, an embassy.

clue.text: Half of change given to minute float

indicators.note: half of means taking only the first half of the word

parts.note: to switch is to change

explanation.surface: A shopkeeper hands over half the change with a tiny tip for the till float.
explanation.walkthrough: 'float' looks like cash in a till; it is a verb, to stay up on water.
explanation.definitionFit: To swim can mean to stay on the surface of water, as things float.

clue.text: Sample of children put under strain by immature types on TV

indicators.note: on means the young ones follow the television in the across entry

parts.note: to test something is to put it under strain
the tube is slang for television
babies are immature people

explanation.surface: A TV programme puts some kids under pressure to test them.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is playful: children from IVF began as a sample in a lab vessel.
explanation.definitionFit: Babies conceived in vitro are jokingly a sample of children, since laboratory glassware holds samples.

clue.text: Died in HGV, about to leave port

indicators.note: in means placed inside the other letters
to leave means the letter for about is dropped

parts.note: a heavy goods vehicle is a lorry or truck
C is short for circa, about
OB is short for obiit, Latin for died

explanation.surface: A man died in a lorry just before it left harbour.
explanation.walkthrough: OB, for obiit, is a gravestone and register abbreviation for died; C for circa means about.
explanation.definitionFit: Tobruk is a Libyan port on the Mediterranean, famous for its Second World War siege.

clue.text: Following recess, alliance vote for city in France

indicators.note: following means the later pieces come after the recess

parts.note: a bay is a recess in a wall or coastline
EU is the European Union, an alliance of states
X is the mark made on a ballot paper

explanation.surface: After the holiday, a European bloc votes on a French city.
explanation.definitionFit: Bayeux is a Normandy town, home of the famous tapestry, which has city status as a cathedral seat.

clue.text: Introduction initially put energy in tramp

indicators.note: initially means just the first letter of put
in means placed inside the other letters

parts.note: to tramp is to walk a long way, to ramble
E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: An opening speech gets a homeless person moving.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tramp' looks like a vagrant; it is a long walk.
explanation.definitionFit: A preamble is an introductory statement before the main text.

clue.text: Trophy in bar wherein Jack is barred

indicators.note: is barred means the jack letter is shut out of the word

parts.note: a jemmy is a crowbar used by burglars
J is the card abbreviation for jack

explanation.surface: A pub where a sailor is banned has an award on show.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bar' looks like a pub; it is a crowbar.
explanation.definitionFit: The Emmy is the American television award, a statuette trophy.

clue.text: Named Le Pen to go before Germany

indicators.note: to go before means the pig enclosure comes in front of the French article

parts.note: a sty is a pen for pigs
D is the international vehicle code for Germany

explanation.surface: French politician Le Pen is set to precede Germany.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Le Pen' reads as the French politician; split it, with 'Le' as itself and 'Pen' as a pig's sty.
explanation.definitionFit: To be styled something is to be called or titled it, so styled means named.

clue.text: What's left here is so flat

definitions.meaning: the number of this clue, 26, which is divisible by two

explanation.definitionFit: The clue's number 26 is divisible by two, and a level surface is smooth, with no bumps.

clue.text: Member of old Chinese ruling class suppressed by Roman church

definitions.text: Member of old Chinese ruling class

indicators.note: suppressed by means kept out of sight within the words that follow

explanation.surface: An ancient Chinese noble is put down by the Catholic Church.
explanation.definitionFit: The Manchu people ruled China as the Qing dynasty until 1912.

clue.text: Girl crowned by Poles?

parts.note: not a Polish coronation: the poles are maypoles, danced round on May Day, when a girl is given a floral crown

explanation.definitionFit: On May Day a village girl is crowned with flowers as the festival's queen beside the maypole.
